메모: 「매진 임박」 이미지 콘티 v5(2026-10-25 — Seedance 시작 · 끝 그림). v4(이미지콘티_v4.json)와 같은 배치도 · 배역 참조로 굽되, 받은 그림은 16:9로 자르기만 하고 색 옮기기 · 밝히기는 하지 않는다(결정 10-24). 그래서 빛을 지시문에 쓴다 — v4 받은 그대로는 원본보다 대비가 세고(L 95분위 60 대 43, 120 넘는 화소 11% 대 0.5%) 얼굴이 밝게 비쳐, 빛 칸을 「낮은 노출 · 부드러운 대비 · 갈색 그림자 · 얼굴은 옆에서 흐리게」로 새로 쓰고 방 기준 그림(R1 · R2)부터 다시 굽는다. 클로즈업은 원본 첫 프레임의 얼굴 상자(YuNet)를 화면 비로 재어 화면 안 경계로 쓴다. 피해자 컷은 모두 공포 먼저(장부 S32). 풀기: node 풀기.mjs --파일 이미지콘티_v5.json → ego/jobs_이미지콘티_v5.json, 받은 그림은 받음/v5/, 고른 판은 정지컷/v5/<컷>.png, 16:9 자르기는 ../영상시작_v5.py, 보드는 ../콘티보드_v5.py.

공통.시작: Create one still photograph. A cinematic film still from a Korean horror-comedy short film, 16:9 frame.
공통.세트_소파: Location: a Korean apartment living room late at night, set for a small night party of three home-shopping superfans. A long, low beige velvet sectional sofa with plump cushions runs along the back wall, and its right end turns toward the camera as an L. A leopard-print fleece blanket is draped over the right part of the sofa, and a cream faux-fur throw lies over the right armrest. In front of the sofa stands a low black coffee table with a crossed metal base, crowded with a night-party mess: lit pillar candles and tea lights, two wine bottles, stemmed glasses, a white fluffy fur cushion, a stack of clear plastic food-storage containers with pastel pink and mint lids, and a long curl of printed paper order receipts hanging over the table edge. A burgundy rug lies under the table on a warm wood-look floor. Behind the sofa, the left part of the back wall is a wide window with sheer white curtains and heavy beige drapes; through it, the lit windows of neighboring Korean apartment towers at night. On the back wall right of center hangs a vertical column of three small framed shadow boxes, each displaying a pastel-pink limited-edition food-container gift box like a collector's treasure, with a small dried-flower wreath beside them. In the right part of the room behind the sofa corner, on a low sideboard: a vintage table lamp whose pleated pink fabric shade glows warm amber, two red taper candles, and a string of tiny warm fairy lights draped along the sideboard and along the back of the sofa.
공통.세트_짧게: Location: the same Korean apartment living room as in Image {n}, late at night — the beige sectional sofa with the leopard-print blanket, the coffee table crowded with candles, wine glasses, pastel food-storage containers and paper order receipts, the curtained window, the framed shadow boxes, the pink-shaded lamp and the fairy lights. Use Image {n} for the room, the set dressing and the light.
공통.강도방: Location: the other side of the same Korean apartment living room at night, as in Image {n} — the white ledge with a candle, the round wall clock, the white door, the iron wall sconce, the crown molding and the beige curtain. Image {n} was shot from this same low camera: keep its room, its light and its camera height and upward tilt.
공통.배치_흐림: Image {n} is a heavily blurred layout guide of this shot: match its camera position, camera height, tilt and lens, and where the large shapes sit in the frame — but ignore its blur, its smudges, its exact furniture and its colors.
공통.배치_실루엣: Image {n} is a layout guide: the black silhouettes show only where the people are in the frame, how big and in what pose — match that placement, size and pose. The silhouettes have no faces, clothes or colors to copy.

공통.강도_옷: THE INTRUDER: a slim Korean man in his twenties wearing a black knit balaclava ski mask with two eye holes and one round mouth hole — his eyes and lips show through the holes, everything else of his head and neck is covered in black knit — a plain black short-sleeved t-shirt and black trousers. His bare forearms are lean. Any knife is a large kitchen knife with a plain steel blade — a film prop, clean, no blood.
공통.강도_카메라: Medium shot from low: the camera is at the eye level of the women sitting on the sofa, about one meter above the floor, tilted up at him, 28mm lens, handheld, shallow depth of field.
공통.사진남1: He is the only person in the frame.
공통.지유_얼굴: Use the four attached photos (Images 1 to 4) only as identity references for one young Korean woman in her early twenties. Keep her face exactly the same in every detail: soft round face with a small chin, dark brown eyes with subtle inner double eyelids and aegyo-sal, small straight nose, natural coral-red lips (not deep red, not pink), bright warm-toned skin with a faint natural blush on the cheeks, and her long straight hair with a center part falling well below her shoulders, no bangs. Her hair is natural jet black (close to #191C1A), not brown, not blue-black, and it stays this shade in the warm lamp light. Ignore the backgrounds, clothing and lighting of the reference photos. Do not add moles, freckles, marks, tattoos, text, logos or watermarks.
공통.리4_얼굴: Use the four attached photos (Images 1 to 4) only as identity references for one Korean woman about 27 years old. Keep her face exactly the same: her round face, her black hair with straight blunt bangs just above the eyebrows, her large round tortoiseshell glasses with clean clear lenses, and the small mole on her cheek exactly where it is in the reference photos. Ignore the backgrounds, clothing and lighting of the reference photos. Do not add other moles, freckles, marks, tattoos, text, logos or watermarks.
공통.통2_얼굴: Use the four attached photos (Images 1 to 4) only as identity references for one Korean woman about 30 years old. Keep her face and body exactly the same: her full round face with soft cheeks and a soft double chin, thick straight dark eyebrows, her short tightly curled dark-brown permed bob, her plus-size figure (163 cm, Korean clothing size 88), and — when her teeth show — only a very narrow gap between her two front teeth (both front teeth fully there). Ignore the backgrounds, clothing and lighting of the reference photos. Do not add moles, freckles, marks, tattoos, text, logos or watermarks.

공통.리4_코케트: a red-and-white gingham cami top with thin straps and a ruffled neckline, white lace-trimmed bloomer shorts, a big red satin ribbon bow and red heart-shaped sunglasses pushed up on top of her head above her bangs — her own round tortoiseshell glasses stay on her face — and her black bob tied into two short low pigtails with small red ribbons, her straight blunt bangs unchanged

공통.배경_소파: Behind her, far out of focus: the beige sofa back, a leopard-print fleece blanket and the soft round warm bokeh of tiny fairy lights.
공통.클로즈업_카메라: Camera: handheld close-up from the height of a man standing over her — a little above her eye level, looking slightly down at her — 85mm lens, very shallow depth of field.

공통.강도_가까이: The camera is close to him, about one meter away and very low, so he towers over the lens: his masked head is near the top edge of the frame and the frame cuts him at the hips.
공통.눈길_왼쪽위: Her eyes look up and to the LEFT side of the frame — her irises sit in the left corners of her eyes, toward the left edge of the frame — at a man standing there out of frame. She does not look at the camera and does not look to the right.
공통.공포_몸짓: The women are TERRIFIED, not calm: shoulders hunched up toward their ears, bodies stiff and leaning back, away from the masked man; they cling to each other's arms and hands; eyes opened wide so the whites show, fixed on him; eyebrows raised and pulled together; lips parted and trembling; faces drained with fear. Nobody smiles, nobody stands relaxed with loose arms.
공통.공포_얼굴: She is TERRIFIED, not sad and not annoyed: her eyes are opened very wide so the whites show around the irises, fixed on the man up and to the left; her eyebrows are raised high and pulled together; her forehead is tense; her nostrils flare; her face is drained with fear. No crying with squeezed-shut eyes, no pout, no frown of annoyance.
공통.빛: Light and color: the ceiling lights are off; the only light comes from warm tungsten lamps, candles and tiny fairy lights (old 2200–2700K bulbs), giving the whole image a warm orange-amber cast. Low exposure and soft, gentle contrast, like a dim night scene on old film: most of the frame is warm dark-brown shadow, the deepest shadows are a dark warm brown rather than pure black, and only the small flames and bulbs themselves are bright — no white or glowing areas, no glossy highlights, no flash, no key light. No pink, magenta, blue or teal light, no colored gels, no neon.
공통.빛_어둡게: Expose about one stop darker than normal — a low-key frame where even the lit side of a face or a wall is only a soft, warm mid-tone. White clothes, white lace and lamp shades stay a muted warm beige in this dim light, never bright white or glowing.
공통.필름: Photorealistic film still with natural skin texture, fine film grain and natural lens falloff, as if shot handheld on a cinema camera at night. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
공통.세트_강도: Location: the other side of the same Korean apartment living room at night, facing away from the sofa toward the entrance. On the left, a white built-in wall cabinet with a deep ledge at chest height like a mantelpiece, holding a lit pillar candle in a glass holder and a small trailing plant, with the edge of a tall white bookshelf at the far left. Center-right, a closed white panel door to the hallway with a silver lever handle. On the wall to the right of the door, a black wrought-iron wall sconce holding a candle in a glass. Above the ledge, a round antique wall clock. White crown molding runs where the beige walls meet the shadowy ceiling. At the far right edge of the frame, a heavy beige curtain. This side of the room is dimmer and more muted than the sofa side: dim brownish-beige walls and a dull off-white door, lit only by the small candle on the ledge, the candle in the wall sconce and the faint warm spill of the party lamps from behind the camera.
공통.강도빛: He is lit only dimly from the front by the faint warm spill of the party lamps behind the camera: his black balaclava and black clothes are a soft, deep brown-black with the knit texture just visible, his bare forearms are warm and dim, and the room behind him is muted and dim.
공통.얼굴빛: Her face is lit only softly and dimly from the side by the warm glow of the nearby lamp, candles and fairy lights: her skin looks warm orange-tan with soft brown shadows, there is no bright highlight or shine on her forehead, nose or cheeks, and one side of her face falls into soft warm shadow.
공통.울음_공포: She is crying in terror — tears on her cheeks, her face crumpled, her eyebrows pulled up and together — and she is frightened, not just sad: her crying is real and desperate, never cute, never pouting.
공통.친구손_하나: The only other thing in the frame is her friend's hand, coming in from the left edge and resting gently on her bare shoulder to comfort her: a small, soft young woman's hand with short natural nails, and the edge of a plain white cotton t-shirt sleeve just visible at the left edge of the frame — the hand of her curly-haired girlfriend sitting right beside her on the sofa. It is clearly a woman's hand, slender and delicate. No other face or body.
공통.친구손_둘: The only other things in the frame are her two girlfriends' hands, one coming in from each side edge and resting gently on her bare shoulders to comfort her: on the left, a small, soft young woman's hand with the edge of a plain white cotton t-shirt sleeve at the left edge; on the right, a slender young woman's hand with a thin ring and a sheer white chiffon sleeve at the right edge. Both are clearly women's hands, slender and delicate. No other face or body.

The background is dark brown with small, soft glowing bokeh dots. Nothing in the frame is bright except the tiny flames and bulbs.

공통.빛_뒤램프_셋: Light direction: the only lamp is behind and to the right of them, so their fronts and their white clothes are on the shadow side — the white t-shirt, white shorts and white satin dress read as dim warm grey-beige, their brightest fold no lighter than the beige sofa behind them; only a faint warm candle glow touches their faces.
공통.빛_뒤램프_하나: Light direction: the only lamp is behind and to the right of her, so her front and her white t-shirt are on the shadow side — the t-shirt reads as a dim warm grey-beige, never bright white, no lighter than the beige sofa behind her; her face is lit only softly from the side by warm candlelight.
공통.빛_촛불_셋: Light direction: the room's lamps are out of frame; the three women are lit only dimly from the front-left by candlelight, so their white t-shirt, white satin dress and white lace veil read as dim warm grey-beige, never bright white; no lamp or lampshade is visible anywhere in the frame — the only bright points are the tiny fairy lights behind them.
